detail.detail: NDVI needs labelled, calibrated Red/NIR surface-reflectance bands. RGB alone cannot answer this request.
For experimental grounding, ask for one category: stadium, car, aircraft, building, ship or sports field.
Temporal masks report predicted change pixels, not object counts or physical area.
This specialist maps water pixels only; it cannot map buildings, count objects or measure physical area.
Upload one optical image or two compatible TIFFs first.
